chemistry.notes: Estimated: LG Chem pouch cells (Wikipedia; Jaguar "pouch cell technology"); an Autocar piece on the I-Pace concept says nickel-cobalt-manganese chemistry (search excerpt). No Jaguar page opened names the chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 432 cells (EV Database, Wikipedia) in a 108s4p layout at about 3.65 V is roughly 390 V nominal, a 400 V-class pack. No page states the voltage.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Jaguar launch material lists battery-and-cabin preconditioning while plugged in (app-started; Wikipedia: Jaguar Remote app can start battery preconditioning); Jaguar US calls it "preconditioning mode". No page describes navigation-triggered warming before a DC charger, so recorded as manual only.

dc_max_kw.notes: Jaguar US 2022 release: 100 kW DC charger adds up to 63 miles in 15 minutes; Wikipedia 100 kW. EV Database measures about 104 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Cars.com says the I-Pace skipped US model year 2021; if a 2021 car exists it carries over the 7 kW charger of 2019-2020 (11 kW began with 2022 in the US). CONFLICT: Wikipedia says later 2021 cars (EU) had 11 kW; a US/CA 2021 car, if any, is unproven at 7 kW.
